caption: Day 5 of 30 family dinners toddlers actually eat 🤍 Oven Beef Mashed Potato 🥔 Ingredients Mashed Potatoes * 4 medium potatoes * 2 garlic cloves * 3 tbsp butter * 2 tbsp cream cheese * ⅓ cup heavy cream * ½ tsp oregano Beef Filling * 12 oz ground beef * ½ small onion * 1 carrot * 1 bell pepper * ½ tsp paprika * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp black pepper * Salt (1 year+ only) Topping * 2 handfuls mozzarella & cheddar cheese Directions Boil the potatoes with the garlic → cook the beef with the onion, carrot, bell pepper, and seasonings → mash the potatoes with butter, cream cheese, oregano, and heavy cream → layer potatoes, beef, potatoes → top with cheese → bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15–20 minutes, then broil until golden ✨ A cozy family dinner that's perfect for meal prep and leftovers 🤍 If you want even more recipes like this, MunchMind has 200+ baby & toddler-approved recipes, plus weekly personalized meal plans already planned for you and grocery lists to make the whole week easier 🤍 Find it in my bio ✨ #familydinner #groundbeefrecipes #toddlermeals #familymeals #toddlerrecipes
